meta.title: Auto-generate ILLink.Substitutions.xml to Remove F# Metadata Resources
meta.body_summary: Auto-generate ILLink.Substitutions.xml during build to remove F# metadata resources (signature, optimization) during IL trimming to reduce assembly size.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot generated core MSBuild task; T-Gro fixed syntax errors, build integration, and test validation; merged after long collaboration and size validation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5357 changed lines across 170 files, this is a large-scale change by absolute volume, but most churn is from merge commits bringing main branch updates; the core feature is a new MSBuild task (~160 lines) and test infrastructure. The merge outcome is consistent: after extensive human fixes and build integration, it was merged.

review_details.concern_detail: T-Gro identified that `[<o>]` instead of `[<Output>]` caused a build error, invalid XML generation, and missing resource embedding; also asked for improved test script to report actual sizes.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduces trimmed assembly size by removing F# metadata resources automatically.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot handled core XML generation logic but introduced syntax errors ([<o>]) and required human intervention for MSBuild integration, test hookup, and resource embedding; demonstrates limitations in build system plumbing and F# attribute syntax.

detection_detail.code_reading: T‑Gro reviewed the F# code and identified `[<o>]` syntax error and XML generation issues.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI build failure revealed the compilation error; subsequent test runs validated size changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after benchmark numbers; maintainer manually verified resource presence and size reduction via test script.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Syntax error, invalid XML, and resource embedding fixed within PR by both Copilot and human commits before final approval and merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added MSBuild task GenerateILLinkSubstitutions.fs that generates an ILLink.Substitutions.xml file listing F# metadata resources to remove during trimming, integrated into build targets and tested with a trimming test project.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most file churn (thousands of lines) comes from merges of main branch bringing in unrelated changes; the core feature is ~160 lines.
change_trajectory: Copilot implemented task with initial version (94 lines) and test project.
T‑Gro review: pointed out syntax error ([<o>]) and XML generation issues.
Copilot addressed feedback: fixed XML, refactored resource array, updated properties.
T‑Gro requested improved test script to report actual sizes; Copilot updated.
Multiple merges of main to keep branch up to date.
T‑Gro registered task, handled special case for FSharp.Core.
After additional formatting fix, PR approved and merged.

review_signals.summary: Flagged `[<o>]` as undefined type causing build failure.
review_signals.action_taken: Fixed by T‑Gro in subsequent commit.

review_signals.summary: Questioned the purpose of `<Output TaskParameter=… ItemName=EmbeddedResource/>`.
Asked to update check.ps1 to output actual size values for the placeholder.
APPROVED after final changes; no additional comments.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR linked to issue, initially with syntax and XML errors.
T‑Gro quickly reviewed and pointed out `[<o>]`, XML mistakes, and test gaps.
Copilot iterated fixing XML, property syntax, and resource prefixes; T‑Gro contributed direct fixes.
Maintainer requested better test output; Copilot added actual size reporting.
PR repeatedly merged with main, accumulating unrelated changes.
After final formatting fix and manual task registration, two maintainers approved and PR merged after ~68 days.
